idea.idea: Why ChatGPT Hallucinates Your Quotations (And How Context-Aware AI Fixes It)
idea.angle: Generic AI fails Indian businesses because it doesn't know your minimum order quantities, GST slabs, or regional freight rules; grounding prompts with local business context changes everything.
idea.audience_problem: Traders test AI for drafting quotes and customer replies, but abandon it when it invents discounts, inaccurate GST calculations, or impossible delivery promises.

hooks: Why your AI-generated business quotes are often wrong
Stop letting AI hallucinate your shop's price quotes
How to fix AI errors in your business quotations
piece.hook_reason: It addresses the specific pain point of inaccurate quotes, which directly relates to the audience's daily business struggles, and promises a fix.

slides.title: Why your AI-generated business quotes are often wrong

slides.myth: AI knows your shop rules like you do
slides.subtitle: AI doesn't naturally know your constraints
slides.title: The AI Trap

slides.body: AI agents operate in a vacuum. Without your specific GST slabs, minimum order quantities, or local freight rules, they make logical guesses that cost you money and credibility.
slides.title: Missing Context

items: Map your current manual quotation workflow
Identify the single most difficult decision step
Feed the AI your specific constraints and rules
Test for speed and accuracy before scaling
slides.title: How to Ground Your AI

items: Check against current GST slab rates
Verify if minimum order quantity applies
Ensure freight charges match your carrier
Review final output for impossible promises
slides.title: Quote Safety Checklist

items: AI needs context to avoid errors
Start with one specific, repetitive task
Always keep a human in the loop
Measure results to justify the investment
slides.title: Key Takeaways

piece.caption: AI tools can draft a quote in seconds, but they often ignore your actual business rules. If you don't feed your AI the exact GST slabs, freight costs, and inventory limits it needs, it will invent numbers that don't exist. AI isn't a replacement for your expertise; it is a tool for decision intelligence. Before you automate, map your process. Identify the exact step where the AI creates the most errors. Feed it your rules as a prompt, and always treat the output as a draft for your review. Never let an AI send a quote to a client without a human sanity check. How do you currently handle complex quotes for your business? #BusinessAI #SmallBizIndia #GST #AutomationTips #TradingBusiness

claims.claim: AI models miss business constraints and relationships without specific operational context.
AI agents in a vacuum may make mistakes or consume excessive computing resources.
Connecting AI to enterprise data and processes helps agents operate within defined guardrails.
The best approach is to start with a specific decision and identify its most difficult steps.
